stories.title: Baycurrent Classic Starts Thursday — Yokohama's Biggest Week

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Schauffele defending. Clark at No. 5 in the world. Matsuyama on home turf. The Baycurrent Classic at Yokohama Country Club starts Thursday — 72 players, no cut, $8M purse.

#BaycurrentClassic #PGATour #FedExCupFall

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
500 FedExCup Fall points up for grabs at Yokohama this week. That's the third-biggest prize remaining in the Fall series. Xander Schauffele is trying to become the first player to defend this title.

#BaycurrentClassic #PGATour

stories.title: LIV Golf Pushes Its Deadline to October 25

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
The LIV Golf player commitment deadline has been pushed from October 13 to October 25. BC Partners confirmed $300M in initial funding. Players who sign get 52.5% equity in the new league — but give up half their unpaid contracts to do it.

#LIVGolf #GolfNews

stories.title: Jeeno Thitikul Wins LOTTE Championship — Fourth Win of 2026

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Jeeno Thitikul drives into the water on 16, loses her 2-shot lead — then makes a 20-foot birdie on 17 and birdies 18 to win the LOTTE Championship by 3. Four wins in 2026. Matching Nelly Korda.

#LPGATour #LOTTEChampionship

stories.title: Wyndham Clark Arrives at Yokohama as the Season's Standout

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Wyndham Clark started 2026 at No. 75 in the world. He won the Byron Nelson. He won the U.S. Open wire-to-wire at Shinnecock Hills. He arrives at Yokohama ranked No. 5 globally. That's a season.

stories.title: LPGA Asian Swing Heads to Shanghai After Hawaii

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
LOTTE Championship: done. Next up for the LPGA Tour — Buick LPGA Shanghai at Sheshan Golf Club, Oct 15-18. Then BMW Ladies Championship in South Korea Oct 22-25. The Asian swing runs three straight weeks.

#LPGATour #BuickLPGAShanghai

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text:
Four wins in 2026. Jeeno Thitikul has matched Nelly Korda and built the strongest case for LPGA Player of the Year heading into the Asian swing. Shanghai in eight days.

#LPGATour #Thitikul
